inputs.goal: Add a median helper to src/stats.ts
inputs.work: Add and export `median(xs: readonly number[]): number` in src/stats.ts. The input may be in any order and must not be mutated. For an odd-length list return the middle value of the sorted list; for an even-length list return the mean of the two middle values. An empty list throws a RangeError. Add tests.
inputs.implementation_plan:
1. Add `median` to src/stats.ts: copy and sort the input numerically, take the middle value, or average the two middle values when the length is even; throw a RangeError on an empty list.
2. Add tests in src/stats.test.ts for odd, even, single-element and empty input.
inputs.implementation_summary: Added `median` to src/stats.ts. It works on unsorted input without mutating it, averages the two middle values for even-length lists and throws a RangeError on an empty list. Tests cover odd, even, single-element and empty input. I ran the full suite and it passes, the new tests cover the behaviour and its edge cases, and the change is complete and verified; nothing else was touched.
